title: cladocolea micrantha
intro: Cladocolea micrantha, commonly known as African spikenard, is a plant species in the family Gesneriaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cladocolea micrantha are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
